name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-animated-goal-point
title: Super Mario World - Animated Goal Point
description:
On a whim I decided to submit this to SMWC. These graphics are for ExAnimating the goalpost in vanilla-style hacks. This works best as Global ExAnimation, which can use the Alternate ExGFX for the tilemap.

This is to be inserted over the original goalpost, which uses palettes 4 and 7.
